payload.title: One CLI login for every Anthus product
payload.description: Build the shared CLI login described in docs/design.md: a Python library (PKCE sign-in, remote sign-in, five secure stores, the memory agent, per-key locks, renewal, logout), one broker per product deployment, and a language-neutral protocol with conformance specs. Adopters: Papyrus first, then Cyclotron and Auritus; Chatticus implements the protocol when it has a CLI. Products stay separate by key namespace, client, discovery data and sessions. Live changes in each product (Cognito callback URL, broker deploy, pages, IAM grant) need Ryan's approval.
